fusions.name: Two-Pronged Chop
fusions.desc: A chop that deals 5 damage, leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds and has a 30% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Crossroads Sweep
fusions.desc: A sweep that deals 11 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and knocks them back 2 tiles, then forks to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 50% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Longer Haft
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

fusions.name: Splinter Off
fusions.desc: Each time you strike with your weapon, a splinter of the blow leaps to the nearest enemy within 4 tiles and deals 5 damage. Once every 6 seconds.
